shots.description: A wide shot frames a lone harbour pilot standing at the end of a wet stone jetty at first light, fishing boats rocking behind them and a bank of low fog holding just offshore.

dialogue.identity: The weathered harbour pilot in their sixties, a low and unhurried voice with a slight rasp

shots.description: a low tracking shot along the waterline as the fog rolls in over the breakwater and swallows the far channel marker, its green light pulsing through the grey.

structured_prompt.overall_soundscape: Swell slaps against the stone jetty and hulls knock softly against their fenders. Rigging ticks in the wind, and a channel bell rings twice as the fog closes in.
structured_prompt.non_diegetic_music: A sparse sustained low string pad at a slow tempo, joined by a single struck piano note and a soft swell of cello that fades at the end.
